# camunda_cluster_wake (Action)

Resume a suspended cluster and wait until it is healthy. Needs Terraform 1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "camunda_cluster_wake" "example" {
  config {
    cluster_id = camunda_cluster.test.id
  }
}

# Run it with:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.camunda_cluster_wake.example
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID
